features: Server-created Razorpay Orders and Standard Checkout
Separate encrypted test and live API credentials
Core checkout, payments, orders, invoices and inventory integration
Signed browser returns and raw-body webhook verification
Confirm orders only after funds are captured
Optional automatic capture of verified authorizations
Configurable payment methods, customer prefill and checkout behavior
Full and partial refunds with provider idempotency and persistent retry protection
Refund status reconciliation and dashboard refund import
Signed ZIP downloads and core marketplace license activation
